source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cell-mediated and antibody-mediated immunity (PDF 177-182).

blocks.text: Hum parh chuke hain ke jab microbes jism par hamla karte hain to macrophages unhein nigal kar foran jawab dete hain. Yeh jawab bohat se microbes ko khatam nahin kar sakta, lekin immune system (difa ki teesri line) ko jawab dene ka waqt de deta hai.

Jab macrophage kisi microbe ko nigalta hai to woh helper T cells ke liye khaas proteins bhi banata hai. Jab helper T cells apne receptors ke zariye in proteins ko pehchante hain to woh fa'al (activate) ho jate hain. Fa'al helper T cells do mutawazi (parallel, saath saath chalne wale) immune responses shuru karte hain: cell-mediated immunity aur antibody-mediated immunity.
